segments.he: מר' נחמן מטולטשין ז"ל שהלך עם מוהרנ"ת ז"ל בתענית אסתר לפנות ערב עם המגילה להתפלל מנחה. ור' נחמן הי' כבר בגילופין (אופגראסט) בשביל שכבר קרוב לפורים, אמר לו מהרנ"ת ז"ל "נחמן ווייס ביסטו אזי אופגרומט פאה געסט אז דארפסט נאך זאגין (אסייעין) "כי בצרה גדולה אנחנו" (שאומרים עננו בשמ"ע של תפלת המנחה שהיא תענית ציבור):
segments.en: The Rav Reb Shneur Zalman heard from the Great Magid, of blessed memory, that one who studies not for Heaven's sake forgets a certain Abaye and Rava passage in the Talmud — and the Magid named which one it was. Afterward it happened that the Rav came to a town of opponents, and a great scholar among them said he would show the Chassid that he cannot truly learn. He asked him: "How many Abaye and Rava debates are there throughout the entire Talmud?" The Rav answered: "You know." The scholar answered yes — and began to recite from his mouth: "Here there is an Abaye and Rava, and here" — and listed every Abaye and Rava debate in the entire Talmud. All except that one Abaye and Rava that the Magid had told him — the one that one who studies not for Heaven's sake forgets. That one he did not mention. And the Rav asked: "Is there no more?" He answered: "No." The Rav said: "But there is that Abaye and Rava!" — and named it. And the scholar's face turned like the bottom of a blackened pot. The Rav said: "Tell the people present — do not think I know this better than he — i.e., all those Abaye and Rava debates. I only know this one — from what I received from the Magid: that one who studies not for Heaven's sake forgets this Abaye and Rava. Therefore when he listed all the Abaye and Rava debates and did not mention this one — I remembered the words of the Magid."
